seltour.s1_text: Drag with the mouse around the part you need. A finished frame can be resized by its corners and sides, or moved by dragging inside it.
seltour.s2_text: The screenshot goes straight to the clipboard and the window closes. Paste it into a messenger or a document. Ctrl+Enter does the same.
seltour.s3_text: Opens the screenshot in the editor: arrows, numbers, frames, text, blur. Enter or a click inside the frame does the same.
seltour.s4_text: Removes the frame so you can select another place. The R and Delete keys do the same.
seltour.s5_text: Top row: record a screen video, take a screenshot of the whole screen, copy text from the picture (recognition), and “From phone”: take a photo with your phone or send a picture from it, and it opens in the editor.
seltour.s6_text: "Translate selection" translates the text in the frame. "Select and translate" waits until you outline the place. The translation appears in a separate small window.
seltour.s7_text: At the bottom: the program language and the settings gear (hotkey, screenshot folder, magnifier).
seltour.s8_text: The cross on the corner of the panel or Esc closes the window without a screenshot. You can repeat this tour from the tray icon menu near the clock.
